notes: Ordered so that each test feeds the next: FindModels discovers a live endpointId,
GenerateImage produces a CDN url for DownloadFile, DownloadFile produces a fileId
for UploadFile, and SubmitRequest produces a requestId for the queue readers.
Only the steps marked billable:true call fal inference; everything else hits free
platform/storage endpoints. fal-ai/flux/schnell is the cheapest, fastest model.
CLI run 2026-08-06 found and fixed three real defects: an ADMIN-only auth
validation endpoint, a flat output schema over nested /v1/models records, and
queue request URLs built from the full endpoint id instead of owner/model.

result.defectFound: Records are {endpoint_id, metadata:{...}} but the declared schema was flat, making 9 of 10 fields unreachable. Fixed by flattening in FindModels.js.

result.note: GET api.fal.ai/v1 /models with key-value parameters; auth header injected correctly.
All optional inputs honoured (seed echoed back, jpeg, 512x512 square).

Not testable under the CLI harness: appmixer-test-component.js:459 mocks saveFileStream as Buffer.from(stream), which throws on an IncomingMessage. Passing a stream is the correct Appmixer pattern (see ai/openai/GenerateImage/GenerateImage.js:27), so this is a harness gap, not a connector defect. Verified live on 2026-08-06 by test-flow-generate-and-file-roundtrip.
Needs a stored fileId, which DownloadFile cannot produce under the CLI harness. Verified live on 2026-08-06 by test-flow-generate-and-file-roundtrip.
Both branches verified: waitForResult=true returns the result inline; waitForResult=false returns queue handles.
fal returns handles under the owner/model base (fal-ai/flux), not the full endpoint id.
Both the statusUrl and the endpointId+requestId branches verified.
result.defectFound: endpointId+requestId built .../fal-ai/flux/schnell/requests/<id>/status, which answers 405 — queue.fal.run routes requests only on owner/model. Fixed via lib.queueBaseId(); also fixes GetRequestResult and CancelRequest.

result.note: Returned the completed image payload via the endpointId+requestId branch.

Already-completed request maps 400 to a readable CancelError. A fresh submit answers 202 CANCELLATION_REQUESTED, so the success path is exercised by test-flow-queue-submit-status-cancel, where CancelRequest hangs directly off SubmitRequest to keep the window tight.
